fixtures.task: Require repository ownership before an approved review can be published.
acceptanceCriteria: Every live publication path rejects an actor whose id differs from the repository owner id.

groundTruth.defect: The new ownership guard is never called by the live publication path.

fixtures.task: Track retry attempts when recording completion events without duplicating logical ledger entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Calls with the same repository id and event id produce one durable entry regardless of attempt number.

groundTruth.defect: Including attempt in the identity check appends a second entry for the same event on retry.

fixtures.task: Cache the most recently written projection while preserving repository isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: Reading an unknown repository returns null and never returns another repository's projection.

groundTruth.defect: The process-global fallback returns the last projection written by a different repository.

fixtures.task: Require repository ownership before an approved review can be published.
acceptanceCriteria: Every live publication path rejects an actor whose id differs from the repository owner id.

fixtures.task: Record retry metadata while keeping completion events idempotent.
acceptanceCriteria: A retry updates the existing repository and event entry instead of appending a duplicate.

fixtures.task: Make reservation persistence idempotent when the same request arrives concurrently.
acceptanceCriteria: Two overlapping calls for the same repository and request persist one reservation, even when neither call has completed yet.

groundTruth.defect: The check occurs before an awaited write and the reservation is marked active afterward, so concurrent calls both persist it.

fixtures.task: Publish a release only after its durable record has been written.
acceptanceCriteria: A failed durable write must be surfaced as a failed publication and must never return the published status.

groundTruth.defect: The catch path swallows the writer failure and returns status published.

fixtures.task: Add zero-based fixed-size partition reads without dropping or duplicating records.
acceptanceCriteria: Every non-final partition contains partitionSize records, and adjacent partitions cover each record exactly once.

groundTruth.defect: The slice end subtracts one even though Array.slice uses an exclusive end, dropping the last record of every partition.

fixtures.task: Cache repository policy reads while keeping writes immediately visible.
acceptanceCriteria: After savePolicy returns, every later loadPolicy call for that repository returns the saved policy rather than a stale cached value.

groundTruth.defect: savePolicy updates the backing map but never updates or invalidates policyCache, so cached reads stay stale.

fixtures.task: Allow an open review to be approved only by the acting repository owner or an explicit approver.
acceptanceCriteria: Authorization is evaluated against actorId; repository metadata must not substitute a different subject.

groundTruth.defect: The permission lookup tests repository.ownerId instead of actorId, so it authorizes based on the wrong subject.

fixtures.task: Retry transient delivery failures up to three times when the transport requires one-time tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Every transport attempt receives a freshly issued token because a failed attempt still consumes its token.

groundTruth.defect: The token is issued before the retry loop and reused after the first attempt has consumed it.

fixtures.task: Migrate legacy events into the current event store during startup.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the migration more than once leaves exactly one current event for each legacy event.

groundTruth.defect: Every run unconditionally appends all legacy events, so startup retries duplicate migrated events.

fixtures.task: Make reservation persistence idempotent when the same request arrives concurrently.
acceptanceCriteria: Overlapping calls for one repository and request share one pending persistence operation, and a failed operation can be retried later.

fixtures.task: Return a structured release publication result instead of throwing persistence failures.
acceptanceCriteria: A successful durable write returns ok true, and a failed write returns ok false with the release id and an error message.

fixtures.task: Add zero-based fixed-size partition reads with explicit boundary metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Adjacent partitions cover each record exactly once, and hasMore is true only when records remain after endExclusive.

fixtures.task: Cache repository policy reads while keeping writes and explicit invalidations coherent.
acceptanceCriteria: savePolicy immediately refreshes the repository cache, and invalidatePolicy forces the next read through the backing store.

fixtures.task: Allow an open review to be approved only by the acting repository owner or an explicit approver.
acceptanceCriteria: Closed reviews reject every actor, while open reviews authorize against actorId and the repository's owner and approver ids.

fixtures.task: Retry transient delivery failures up to three times when the transport requires one-time tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Each attempt receives a freshly issued token, success stops retries, and the final failure is surfaced.

fixtures.task: Migrate legacy events into the current event store during startup.
acceptanceCriteria: The migration can resume safely, uses stable event identity, and a completed migration is a no-op on later startups.

fixtures.task: Cache repository projections without allowing stale or cross-repository reads.
acceptanceCriteria: Cache entries are keyed by repository, writes refresh the matching entry, deletes clear it, and unknown repositories return null.
